_comment: Demo-only consumer wording. Keys are API message codes (api/messages) or demo chrome codes. A key 'CODE.go_now' is used instead of 'CODE' when the advice is to go now. Numbers in params are rounded to whole units before rendering. No contractions.
BEST_WINDOW: This is your best window today.
WORSE_LATER: After that, conditions turn against you.
HEAT_RISES: {wbgt_c} °C heat stress in your window, {peak_wbgt_c} °C at {peak_time}. Above {indoor_line_c} °C we suggest training indoors.
HEAT_RISES.go_now: {wbgt_c} °C heat stress now, {peak_wbgt_c} °C at {peak_time}. Above {indoor_line_c} °C we suggest training indoors.
AIR_CLEAN: The air stays clean all day.
AIR_PEAK_LATER: {pollutant} rises to {peak_ugm3} µg/m³ by {peak_time}. It is {window_ugm3} in your window.
AIR_PM_EPISODE: Smoke and dust peak at {peak_ugm3} µg/m³ at {peak_time}. It is {window_ugm3} in your window.
POLLEN_PEAK_AVOIDED: Pollen peaks at {peak} grains/m³. Your window stays below 50.
POLLEN_HIGH_IN_WINDOW: Pollen is high even in your window ({window} grains/m³).
POLLEN_NOT_COVERED: No pollen forecast for this area.
COLD_WARM_UP: Wind chill {wind_chill_c} °C into the wind. Warm up indoors and keep the first kilometre easy.
WIND_START_INTO: {wind_word} {from} wind. Start into it, and it is behind you on the way home.
WIND_LIGHT: Light wind, so any direction works.
ATHLETE_NOT_ADAPTED: Not used to heat yet, {mass_kg} kg, {height_cm} cm.
TIMELINE_ARIA: Your window {start} to {end}, on a timeline from now ({now}) to {day_end}
COUNTERFACTUAL_HEAT: You miss the hottest part of the day. At {peak_time}, heat stress is {delta_c} °C higher.
CREDITS: Weather and air: Open-Meteo / ERA5 (CC BY 4.0) · Map © OpenStreetMap contributors
CREDITS_DATA: Weather and air: Open-Meteo / ERA5 (CC BY 4.0)

ONB_INTRO: So your advice fits you, not an average runner.
ONB_HEAT: Are you used to running in heat?
ONB_CONSENT: Your answers stay on this phone and only shape your advice.
TOMORROW.GO_AT_SHORT: Tomorrow: run at {start}, keep it short
TOMORROW_BODY_air: The air gets worse after that.
TOMORROW_BODY_cold: It is bitterly cold before that.
TOMORROW_BODY_indoor: Too hot for a safe run outside all day.
NO_MESSAGE: No message tonight: tomorrow suits your usual run.
GLANCE_RING_ARIA: Your window {start} to {end} on a 12-hour dial
ROUTE_LOOP: {name} loop, {loop_km} km. {laps_word} laps fit your {minutes} minutes
ROUTE_LOOP_ONE: {name} loop, {loop_km} km. One lap fits your {minutes} minutes
ROUTE_AIR: Cleaner air than {compared_with}: {saving_pct}% less traffic pollution
AFTER_SUB_AIR: You missed the worst of the air.
AFTER_HEAT_AVOIDED: At {time}, heat stress would have been {delta_c} °C higher.
AFTER_FEEL: Compared with your usual run, it felt…
FEEL_THANKS: Thanks. This tunes your next advice.
AFTER_INDOOR_AVOIDED: Outside, heat stress peaked at {peak_c} °C at {time}.
WEEK_LATER: The week view arrives in step 4.
ROUTE_LOOP_SHORT: {name} loop, {loop_km} km. Turn back halfway to keep to {minutes} minutes
AFTER_WATER_NONE: You sweated about {ml} ml, no need to top up.
AFTER_WATER_NONE_CMP: You sweated about {ml} ml, no need to top up. At {time} it would have been about {worst_ml} ml.
AFTER_WATER_DRINK: You sweated about {ml} ml, so drink about that much in the next hour.
AFTER_WATER_DRINK_CMP: You sweated about {ml} ml, so drink about that much in the next hour. At {time} it would have been about {worst_ml} ml.
AFTER_WATER_DRINK_LOCAL: You sweated about {ml} ml, so drink about that much in the next hour: {drink}.
AFTER_WATER_DRINK_CMP_LOCAL: You sweated about {ml} ml, so drink about that much in the next hour: {drink}. At {time} it would have been about {worst_ml} ml.
